Game Overview

Little Dentist for Kids 2 puts players into a surgery experience centered on step into the shoes of a dentist and give little patients bright, healthy smiles. Use fun tools to clean teeth, zap cavities, and remove plaque in this engaging, child-friendly game. Enjoy vibrant graphics and a playful atmosphere as you turn dental care into an exciting adventure.
